name: Pewang Gole
tagline: I build small, useful apps and write down who helped.
description: Portfolio of Pewang Gole: Toolbelt, GoleSync, RaGo Lens and CareCompanion, and the people, tools and open-source projects behind them.
heroLine: I build small, practical apps that work on your own phone and your own network, and I like to say thank you out loud.
intro: These apps started as things I wanted for myself or that someone close to me asked for. Each one is a tool: it should do one job and do it without asking for an account.
Every app page says plainly what is released, what is still being built, and what I have not confirmed yet.
gratitudeNote: None of this was built alone. The people, tools and open-source projects behind each app are on the thanks page.
footerThanks: Thank you to everyone who helped.

howIBuild.intro: I plan my ideas in conversation with Claude, build them with Claude Code, and then test and review the result myself on real devices.

steps.title: Plan in conversation
steps.text: I talk an idea through with Claude until the scope and the first version are clear.

steps.title: Build with Claude Code
steps.text: Claude Code writes and changes the code in my repositories while I direct it.

steps.title: Test and review
steps.text: I install the build on real devices, use it, and review what changed before anything is released.

aiHelped.text: Turning a rough idea into a plan and a task list.
Writing and refactoring code that I then read and run.

iDecided.text: What to build, what to leave out, and what counts as ready to release.
Whether something works: I check it on a real device rather than trusting a description of it.

howIBuild.limits: AI makes mistakes, so nothing on this site is a claim I have not checked. Where I have not confirmed something yet, it is marked as unconfirmed or left out.
